items.heading: Most Advice Online Skips Straight
items.text: Most Advice Online Skips Straight Most Advice Online Skips Straight Most advice online skips straight to "here are alternative careers" without addressing the part that actually matters first: bank exams are not a one-shot, attempt-capped step the way UPSC is. IBPS and SBI notify PO and Clerk vacancies every single year, and neither sets a hard limit on how many times you can apply, only an age ceiling.

items.heading: If You Have Been Reading
items.text: If you have been reading UPSC recovery content or hearing "attempts are running out" language from coaching centres, it is worth seeing how differently bank exams are actually structured.

items.heading: Prelims Has No Sectional Cutoff,
items.text: Prelims has no sectional cutoff, only an overall cutoff, so a weak section can be offset by a strong one.

items.heading: A Prelims Miss Usually Points
items.text: A prelims miss usually points to raw speed and accuracy under time pressure, not conceptual gaps.

items.heading: Fix
items.text: Fix: increase timed mock volume and sectional time allocation before adding new topics.
